name: OpenReplay
summary: Self-hosted session replay, cobrowsing and product analytics that keep user data inside your own infrastructure.
description: Open-source experience platform you host yourself: replay sessions with full DevTools context (network, console, JS errors, store state, 40+ performance metrics), analyze funnels, trends, journeys, heatmaps and web analytics, and co-browse live over WebRTC. Capture-time masking, private mode and GDPR/CCPA tooling; deploy on a single VM, Kubernetes, Docker or from source, with cloud options including dedicated instances in 50+ regions.
contains: self-hosted session replay (free) plus serverless, dedicated and bring-your-own-cloud options
DevTools: network, console, JS errors, store state, 40+ performance metrics
analytics: funnels, trends, journeys, heatmaps, web analytics
cobrowsing with cursor control and WebRTC calls
capture-time sanitization and private mode (mask all text and inputs)
native mobile replay for iOS, Android and React Native (beta)
deploys on a 2 vCPU / 8 GB / 50 GB VM, Kubernetes (Helm), Docker or from source
